_comment: The active ETS release — a pinned tuple across the version axes (see VERSION_SCHEME.md). This file is the single source of truth for 'what am I running'.
release: engine-v1 · ui-v6 · psytech (local) | cloud: anchor-fit offload (cloud-mvp1)

ui.title: THE FIELD — one unified push/zoom surface of squares (replaces pad grid + XY pad + drill-in); brightness = live settled telemetry; hover-scroll bias via the existing region-tilt lane; self-sizing zoom drill (participation-ratio noise floor)
ui.auditor: PASS-WITH-NOTES, all NOTE-class, notes fixed pre-merge (2026-07-17)

deployment.title: hosted anchor-fit training service (offloads the GW-barycenter geometry off the local machine)
deployment.boundary: only stage-3 gauge-invariant cost matrices + masses cross device->cloud (CS-1..CS-5, verified biting); raw audio + stage-2 recipes never uploaded; no cloud decoder; world returns with device-verifiable receipts
deployment.wall: NCE LAMBDA fit + scramble exam stay DEVICE-LOCAL (they consume stage-2 recipe data -> cannot cross CS-1); full cloud training is a follow-up needing a prototype-only exam reformulation
deployment.deploy: LIVE on Railway (project 'thorough-serenity', service Geodesic-Mixing) at https://geodesic-mixing-production.up.railway.app — deployed from a code-only build context (ets/ + cloud/ only; no corpus/worlds/samples uploaded). Single-user bearer gate ACTIVE (ETS_TRAIN_TOKEN): unauthenticated /train -> 401; authorized real stage-3 job -> 200 + verifiable receipt (end-to-end confirmed 2026-07-17). /health probe green.

deployment_mvp2.title: sealed local companion + browser instrument (drag-drop ingest, guarded cloud train, live play/steer)
deployment_mvp2.status: LIVE (demo phase) on Railway service ets-web
deployment_mvp2.auditor: phase 1 PASS; phase 2 FAIL->fixed->PASS-WITH-NOTES; phase 3 (seam+sigma_phi) PASS-WITH-NOTES->notes fixed (2026-07-17)
deployment_mvp2.boundary: loopback-only server; drag-drop ingest stays local (never forwarded); only stage-3 crosses to Railway via the whitelist encoder; render is LOCAL (no cloud decoder); region-tilt is the sole engine-control gesture (door held); eardrum cap on every produced bar; browser makes zero external calls
deployment_mvp2.seam: WIRED: /api/train on raw audio runs the full train->play seam (local ingest -> cloud anchor-fit -> local build_index -> per-corpus sigma_phi calibration measured+embedded -> playable .etsworld referencing local audio) and REPOINTS the player at the user's trained world (is_trained:true, plays AND steers). CS-1 held (only stage-3 crosses, verified). reset() reverts to the demo. sigma_phi is MEASURED (untilted settlement, no invented floor), not fabricated; no engine edit. Corpus-dependent: region steering arms only when the corpus has bar-to-bar region fluctuation; a degenerate corpus honestly disarms region (surfaced in /api/world armed/disarmed + UI dim + warning).
deployment_mvp2.engine: runs on architecture-v6 ets (engine-v1 + live cap); arch-v6 pinned first on sys.path (verified under the -m import order)
deployment_mvp2.verified: cloud suite 39/39; seam_verify.py (LIVE Railway): trained world builds, embedded sigma_phi (no STALE), steered bar DIFFERS from u=0 (steering live), all bars eardrum-capped
deployment_mvp2.deploy_demo_phase: ets-web-production.up.railway.app, deployed 2026-07-17 from GitHub main (2490c761) after ets-auditor PASS-WITH-NOTES (notes fixed): access-key gate (ETS_ACCESS_KEYS), shared-demo-engine + LRU memory bounds (OOM fix for the measured 8GB kills), opt-in share + Explore, PLAY/TRAIN/EXPLORE tabs, signal-bound progress. Service sources cloud/companion/railway.json from the repo — deploys are now git pushes to main. Live-verified: /api/health ok, access page served, gated routes 401 without key.
